title: Unit 4: We like stories
content:
Characters: Mum, Little Red Riding Hood (Red) Setting: Mum and Little Red Riding Hood are in a small house. Mum is packing a basket of food.

Mum: My dear, your lonely grandma is as sick as a dog. Can you take this basket of food to her, please? She's not able to get out of bed.

(Little Red Riding Hood takes the food basket from Mum.)

Red: Sure! If I were her, I'd like to rest more.

Mum: Good girl. There are fierce animals in the forest, so be careful and stay on the safe path. Remember, don't talk to strangers!

Red: Yes, Mum.

Characters: Wolf, Little Red Riding Hood (Red) Setting: Little Red Riding Hood is walking alone in the forest. Wolf jumps onto the path.

Wolf: Why are you in such a hurry, little girl?

Red: Hmm... I'm going to visit my grandma. She's not well.

Wolf: If I were you, I'd bring flowers to cheer her up. I saw some beautiful flowers near the trees and they're as colourful as a rainbow. Why don't you pick some?

(Little Red Riding Hood looks around nervously.)

Red: Well... If Mum knew it, she'd be angry with me.

Wolf: Follow me. It won't take you long.

Student Name: Nathan Chan; Date: 8 November 20XX; Author: The Brothers Grimm; Characters: Little Red Riding Hood, Mum, Grandma, Wolf, Hunter

This book is about a girl called Little Red Riding Hood. One day, her mum asks her to visit her sick grandma.

In the forest, Little Red Riding Hood meets a wicked wolf who tells her to pick flowers for her grandma. When she picks flowers, the wolf runs to Grandma's cottage and locks Grandma in a wardrobe. When Little Red Riding Hood arrives, the wolf pretends to be her grandma. The greedy wolf wants to eat them both!

In the end, a hunter saves Little Red Riding Hood and her grandma.

This is a wonderful story with great characters. My favourite character is the hunter because he is as brave as a lion. The story also teaches a good lesson. If I were Little Red Riding Hood, I would be more obedient to my mum and listen to her advice.

metadata.preReadingPrompt: Nathan likes the storybook Little Red Riding Hood. Read parts of the play script about the story with him. Then read Nathan's book report on the storybook.

supplementary.learningElementsMarkdown:
### 📌 Inserted Learning & Skill Elements

- **Values Education:** **Learn from stories**  
  - What would you do differently if you were Little Red Riding Hood?
  - Would you follow Wolf? Why or why not?

- **Reading Skill (Understanding attitudes and feelings through language choice):**  
  We can understand people's attitudes and feelings by looking at the choice of language in a text. They are usually adjectives. Read the underlined words. They tell us that Nathan really likes the story.  
  - This is a wonderful story with great characters.
  - ... The story also teaches a good lesson.

- **Partner Activity:**  
  What is your favourite story? What is it about? Tell your partner.
